Convert SIU report HTML to plain text

Source: R/parse_siu.R
siutxt.Rd

Strips the markup from one SIU director's report page and returns the readable text, keeping line breaks so section headings (“Subject Officials”, “Witness Officials”) stay on lines of their own. Use it before siuso(), or to read or search a saved report without a browser.

Usage

siutxt(html)

Arguments

html

A length-1 character vector holding the raw HTML of one report page. A file path is not read here (use siuprs(), which accepts a path).

Value

A length-1 character vector of plain text.

Details

The conversion runs in the native core: tags are removed, block-level tags become line breaks, HTML entities are decoded and runs of spaces are collapsed while newlines are kept. Nothing is fetched and nothing is written.

Errors: html must be a single non-NA character string (“html must be a single non-NA character string”), and input over 2 MiB is refused (“html is larger than 2 MiB: not a report page”).

Limits

The input is capped at 2 MiB (a report page is a few hundred KB). Before the text is read, a line longer than 2000 characters is split at the sentence end nearest the cap (else at a space), and a warning says how many lines were split: a field that spans a split may be incomplete.

Examples

siutxt("<p>Number of SIU Investigators assigned: 3</p>")
#> [1] " Number of SIU Investigators assigned: 3\n"

# the bundled synthetic report, as text
f <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "siu_synthetic_report.html",
  package = "rmoriebricklayer"
)
txt <- siutxt(paste(readLines(f), collapse = "\n"))
cat(substr(txt, 1, 200))
#> 
#> 
#> SIU Director's Report - Case # 23-OFD-001
#> 
#> The Investigation
#> Notification of the SIU
#> On January 6, 2023, the Barrie Police Service contacted the SIU with the
#> following information. It reported that 

# more than one string is refused
try(siutxt(c("<p>a</p>", "<p>b</p>")))
#> Error : `html` must be a single string (the report page)
